name: Moving
overview: Scripture teaches that moving—whether moving away from sin, moving forward in faith, or moving on from past troubles—requires trusting the Lord wholeheartedly and not relying on our own understanding. Believers are encouraged to release past burdens and anxieties, as God promises peace and a hopeful future. By seeking first God's kingdom and righteousness, Christians can confidently navigate life's changes, knowing that God provides for their needs and empowers them to overcome obstacles.
